Digital Clock Custom Mounted into Original Bezel




Dakota Digital's unique custom shop can help you achieve your digital instrumentation dreams! Our craftsmen can rebuild your OEM clock with a Vacuum Florescent Display (VFD) clock using your stock (OEM) clock housing for your car or truck. This will keep the original look of the vehicle while updating the gauges to the latest in digital instrumentation technology. Just send in the original clock housing from your vehicle and we will do all the custom fabrication and mounting here at the factory.

Please prepare the bezel or instrument housing as you would to finish the car (i.e. paint, chrome, polish, etc.) before sending the bezel and housing to us. If you have any questions about your dash, please contact us to discuss them.

* Please call to order.
** Covered by a Limited Lifetime Warranty!
*** See below for standard color options: Blue or Teal.
